description: Authoritative reproducible synthetic baseline dataset for ORCA prototype workflows (Fishers, Researchers, Coastal Authorities, Disaster Management, Maritime Operators). Modeled after official provider schemas from INCOIS, IMD, and MOSDAC/ISRO.

incois.provider: Indian National Centre for Ocean Information Services (INCOIS)
intended_use: Ocean State Forecasts (wave height, currents, sea surface temperature)
products: INCOIS PFZ Mission Integrated Multilingual Advisories

intended_use: Coastal Weather Bulletins (wind speed, gust, direction, visibility)
Cyclone & Severe Weather Marine Warning Bulletins
products: RSMC New Delhi Tropical Cyclone Warning Division Bulletins

mosdac.provider: Meteorological & Oceanographic Satellite Data Archival Centre (MOSDAC / ISRO)
intended_use: Satellite Earth Observation (EO) context: chlorophyll-a concentration and thermal sea surface temperature
products: Oceansat-3 Ocean Colour Monitor (OCM) Level-3 Chlorophyll-a Grid
INSAT-3D/3DR Thermal Sea Surface Temperature Grid

intended_use: Stakeholder identities, fishers, vessels, voyages, routes, notifications, replay tracks, geofences

intentional_quality_cases.condition: Observation timestamp is 20 hours old with is_stale=True, qc_flag=9, and qc_status=STALE.
Nullable measurements (wind_gust_knots, wave_period_sec) are explicitly null/None (source sentinel -999.0), NOT zero.
Observation flagged with qc_flag=1 and qc_status=DEGRADED_QC_WARNING.
Satellite pixel has QA_FLAGS=1 (Cloud Obscured) with CHL_A=null and cloud_fraction=0.85.
PFZ candidate validity window expired prior to reference time (valid_to < REFERENCE_TIME).
PFZ candidate located 165 km offshore (> 120 km query radius).
Severe cyclone squall warning actively overlapping trip-03 and vessel-03.
Replay GPS track moves past Malvan North boundary and near coral sanctuary perimeter.
